schema_desc.agent_role: Defines the system-level role, persona, or behavioral guidelines.
schema_desc.model: Specifies the underlying LLM configuration to use.
schema_desc.temperature: Controls randomness or creativity of the model.
schema_desc.max_tokens: Maximum number of tokens to generate per response.
schema_desc.top_p: Considers cumulative probability mass for token sampling.
schema_desc.presence_penalty: Penalizes words based on their presence to encourage new topics.
schema_desc.frequency_penalty: Penalizes words based on their frequency to reduce repetition.
schema_desc.prompt: Enter the specific prompt or detailed instruction for this node's task.
schema_desc.description: Describes the purpose of this workflow or node. For an agent: its task description and working rules, followed on every task; the first line helps the team lead route work.
schema_desc.graph: The underlying definition and configuration of the graph.
schema_desc.nodes: The sequence of processing nodes contained in this workflow.
schema_desc.edges: Directed data edges defining how nodes connect.
schema_desc.start: Target start nodes for workflow entry.
schema_desc.end: Target end nodes for final workflow data collection.
schema_desc.vars: Global parameters that can be universally referenced.
schema_desc.memory: Optional memory stores that can be continuously referenced.
schema_desc.id: Identifier for referencing. No spaces allowed.
schema_desc.name: Short, human-readable label.
schema_desc.type: Defines the execution mechanism of the component.
schema_desc.condition: Data will only traverse if this computes to true.
schema_desc.trigger: Specified if this edge triggers downstream execution.
schema_desc.from: Data source startpoint of the edge.
schema_desc.to: Data target endpoint of the edge.
schema_desc.is_majority_voting: Decides whether the workflow computes a majority vote logic.
schema_desc.context_window: Maximum amount of context tokens the model can read at once.
schema_desc.api_key: API Key token for the LLM service.
schema_desc.params: Additional custom parameters passed to the model.
schema_desc.auto_fill: Auto completes mandatory missing data elements.
schema_desc.timeout: Maximum wait time for a single calling session.
schema_desc.headers: Custom HTTP headers for the network request.
schema_desc.command: Underlying shell command to be executed.
schema_desc.args: Optional array of shell command arguments.
schema_desc.cwd: Current working directory setting for environments.
schema_desc.inherit_env: Specifies whether to inherit host env variables.
schema_desc.startup_timeout: Wait timespan tolerance for initial startup.
schema_desc.wait_for_log: Checks log line output to ensure readiness.
schema_desc.retrieve_stage: Stage instruction for retrieval context engine.
schema_desc.top_k: How many related chunk blocks should be returned max.
schema_desc.retry: Configuration logic when handling temporary failures.
schema_desc.enabled: Whether this piece of module is activated.
schema_desc.retry_on_status_codes: Activate retry handling upon hitting specific error codes.
schema_desc.retry_on_exception_types: Trigger retry mechanisms only if the exception matches.
schema_desc.non_retry_exception_types: Exceptions mapped as permanently fatal that will never be retried.
schema_desc.retry_on_error_substrings: Retry triggered by particular error text strings.
schema_desc.content: Plain text emitted whenever the node executes.
schema_desc.max_iterations: How many times the loop can run before this node emits an output.
schema_desc.max_duration: How long the loop can run before this node emits an output.
schema_desc.duration_unit: Unit of time for the maximum duration: seconds, minutes, or hours.
schema_desc.message: Optional text sent downstream once the limit is reached.
schema_desc.reset_on_emit: Whether to reset the internal counter or timer after reaching the limit.
schema_desc.passthrough: If enabled, after emitting the limit message, all subsequent inputs pass through unchanged.
schema_desc.interpreter: Python executable path; defaults to the interpreter of the current process.
schema_desc.only_last_message: If enabled, only the last received message is passed on; otherwise all messages are passed.
schema_desc.keep_message: Always keep this message input in the target node so it is not cleared.
schema_desc.clear_context: Clear all incoming context messages (except kept ones) before passing the new payload.
schema_desc.clear_kept_context: Clear messages marked as kept before passing the new payload.
schema_desc.carry_data: Whether to pass data to the target node.
schema_desc.log_output: Whether to log this node's output. Turn off to avoid logging outputs.
schema_desc.process: Optional payload processor applied after the condition is met (regex extraction, custom functions, etc.).
schema_desc.dynamic: Dynamic expansion for the connection: Map (fan-out) or Tree (fan-out + reduce) mode.
schema_desc.skills: Agent Skills allowlist and built-in skill tools.
schema_desc.pattern: Python regular expression used to split or extract content.
schema_desc.template: Optional template applied to the extracted value.
schema_desc.mascot: Character representing this node, shown the same in the workflow editor, the run screen and the Office.
schema_desc.connection: Account signed in on the Connections page (Claude, ChatGPT, Google). The agent calls the model with this account.
schema_desc.allow: Skills the agent may use. Leave empty to allow every discovered skill.
schema_desc.any: True when the content contains any keyword in the list.
schema_desc.none: If the content contains any excluded keyword, the condition is false (highest priority).
schema_desc.regex: True when any regular expression in the list matches.
schema_desc.cache_ttl: Seconds to cache the MCP tool list; set 0 to always fetch the latest list.
schema_desc.case_sensitive: Whether matching distinguishes uppercase and lowercase letters.
schema_desc.default_value: Content used instead when there is no match (applies when "No Match Behavior" = default).
schema_desc.dotall: Enable DOTALL mode (re.DOTALL): the dot also matches newline characters.
schema_desc.multiline: Enable multiline mode (re.MULTILINE): ^ and $ match at each line.
schema_desc.multiple: Collect all matches instead of only the first one.
schema_desc.file_sources: List of file sources to load into memory.
schema_desc.file_types: Only include files with these extensions (e.g. .md, .txt).
schema_desc.group: Name or number of the capture group. Defaults to the whole match (group 0).
schema_desc.group_size: Number of items in each group when merging results.
schema_desc.json_path: Dot-separated path to the array to split (e.g. items, data.results).
schema_desc.max_items: Maximum number of memory items kept (the oldest are dropped first).
schema_desc.max_parallel: Maximum number of executions running in parallel.
schema_desc.on_no_match: What to do when the expression does not match the content.
schema_desc.prefix: Prefix added to every tool name from this source to avoid name clashes (e.g. mcp1).
schema_desc.split: How the data on the edge is split into parts to run in parallel.
schema_desc.tool_sources: Only include MCP tools whose meta.source is in the list; empty defaults to mcp_tools.
schema_desc.organization: Organization used when calling the provider's API.
schema_desc.team: Turns this agent into a team lead (CTO / PM / CEO): you only chat with the lead, and the lead delegates work to the members.
schema_desc.members: IDs of the agent nodes the lead can delegate to. Empty = every agent node without any edges.
schema_desc.plan_approval: For new work, the lead presents a plan (tech stack, architecture, tasks) and waits for your approval, unless you already said to just go ahead.
schema_desc.max_delegations: Limits the number of delegations (delegate_task) in one reply, to keep token usage under control.
schema_desc.max_review_rounds: How many times an unsatisfactory task is sent back for fixes before the lead reports to you.

workflow_descriptions.AgentDev_v1: AgentDev multi-agent software development workflow with planning, coding, review, and testing loops.
workflow_descriptions.blender_3d_builder_hub: Orchestrator-driven architecture with separated Geometry and Lookdev phases.
workflow_descriptions.data_visualization_enhanced_v3: Data visualization process (including preliminary profiling, data cleaning and assessment, multi-graph plan breakdown, and iterative review)
workflow_descriptions.deep_research_executor_sub: Executor subgraph that searches, fans out URL summarizers, and aggregates research summaries.
workflow_descriptions.deep_research_v1: Deep research workflow with demand analysis, planning, web executor subgraph, and report writing.
workflow_descriptions.demo_claude: Claude (anthropic provider) demo: tool use to fetch the temperature, then clothing advice.
workflow_descriptions.demo_loop_counter: LoopCounter demo that releases output on the third iteration.
workflow_descriptions.demo_simple_memory: Simple memory-backed article generation and expansion workflow.
workflow_descriptions.net_example_en: Article generation and polishing workflow with poem and editor feedback.
workflow_descriptions.react: Subgraph-wrapped ReAct agent supporting multi-turn tool calls.
workflow_descriptions.software_company: Software company (web, web app, desktop). You chat only with the CTO: it analyses the request, proposes a plan for your approval, delegates to the right specialists (PM, architect, data, backend, frontend, UI/UX, bug fixer, QA, acceptance, DevOps) and reports back.
workflow_descriptions.marketing_agency: Marketing agency. You chat only with the Marketing Director (CMO): it clarifies goal, audience and budget, proposes a campaign plan for your approval, delegates to the right specialists (research, strategy, copy, SEO, social media, ads, brand visuals, analytics) and hands back ready-to-use deliverables.
workflow_descriptions.content_studio: Content studio (blog posts, articles, newsletters, guides). You chat only with the Editor-in-chief: it agrees topic, angle and audience, proposes an outline for approval, then runs research and fact-checking, writing, SEO editing and proofreading, and hands you the finished piece.
workflow_descriptions.video_studio: Video studio (YouTube, TikTok/Reels, ads, explainers). type.map: Fan-out only: split into parallel units and collect results
type.tree: Fan-out and reduce: split into units, then iteratively reduce results
type.function: Delegate message transformation to Python functions in workspace/functions/edge_processor.
type.keyword: Declarative conditions based on include/exclude keywords or regex matching
type.regex_extract: Extract payload fragments via Python regular expressions.
type.simple: Lightweight store of past outputs with keyword retrieval (no API key); persists when memory_path is set
type.file: Indexes local files on disk; keyword search by default (no API key)
type.blackboard: Shared blackboard memory allowing multiple nodes to read/write
type.agent: Agent execution node backed by configured LLM/tool providers with support for tooling, memory, and thinking extensions.
type.human: Pauses graph and waits for human operator response
type.subgraph: Embeds (through file path or inline config) and runs another named subgraph within the current workflow
type.passthrough: Forwards prior node output downstream without modification
type.literal: Emits the configured text message every time it is triggered
type.loop_counter: Blocks downstream edges until the configured iteration limit is reached, then emits a message to release the loop.
type.loop_timer: Blocks downstream edges until the configured time limit is reached, then emits a message to release the loop.
type.message: Each input message becomes one unit
type.config: Inline subgraph definition embedded directly in the YAML graph
type.reflection: LLM reflects on its output and refine its output
type.mcp_remote: Connect to an HTTP-based MCP server
type.mcp_local: Launch and connect to a local stdio MCP server

log_level.DEBUG: Verbose developer logging; useful when debugging graph behavior.
log_level.INFO: High-level execution progress and key checkpoints.
log_level.WARNING: Recoverable problems that require attention but do not stop the run.
log_level.ERROR: Errors that abort the current node or edge execution, even the entire workflow.
log_level.CRITICAL: Fatal issues that stop the workflow immediately.

retrieve_stage.gen: Main generation stage; also covers tool calling.
retrieve_stage.finished: Finalization stage for cleanup and summary.

on_no_match.pass: Leave the content unchanged when no match is found.
on_no_match.default: Apply default_value (or empty string) if nothing matches.
on_no_match.drop: Discard the payload entirely when the regex does not match.
on_no_match.empty: Return empty content when no match is found.
